description: Recreation of Nevermore Engine's soft shutdown service for restarting Roblox servers on update without losing players.

Server/SoftShutdownServiceUtils.luau.description: Shared server-side rules for identifying soft-shutdown waiting servers. Public entry points include `SoftShutdownServiceUtils.isReservedServer`, `SoftShutdownServiceUtils.isLobbyTeleportPlayer`, `SoftShutdownServiceUtils.promiseIsLobby`, `SoftShutdownServiceUtils.containsPending`.

SoftShutdownService.luau.description: This service lets you shut down servers without losing players. When game.OnClose is called, players in the server are teleported into a reserved lobby server. When the reserved server starts up, it teleports everyone back into updated servers. Public entry points include `SoftShutdownService.Init`, `SoftShutdownService.Start`, `handleLobbyStatus`, `SoftShutdownService.Destroy`.
